purpose: Every director shall inform the company concerned about his disqualification under section 164 in Form DIR-8 before he is appointed or re-appointed.
when: Before he is appointed or re-appointed.
steps: Check for any disqualification under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) of section 164.
Inform the company concerned about the disqualification using Form DIR-8 before appointment or re-appointment.
checklist: Verify if there is any disqualification under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) of section 164.
Prepare Form DIR-8 with the necessary disqualification information.
Ensure Form DIR-8 is ready before appointment or re-appointment.
watch: Form DIR-8 must be filed before appointment or re-appointment.
